name: Lunch Time
source:
It’s your first day at SwifTech University, and you’ve already found drama. Student Council President Ekai and Professor Keyon evidently have a troubled past – can you find out why?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
这才是你在斯威夫特科技大学的第一天，就已经撞上了八卦风波。学生会长伊凯与基恩教授之间显然有着一段剪不断理还乱的过往——你能查明其中的缘由吗？

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]]
